chunks: And from him, from Musa ibn Ja'far, from Ahmad ibn Bashir al-Raqqi, from Ali ibn Asbat, from al-Batih'i, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who married a woman based on a surah from the Book of Allah, then divorced her before consummating the marriage with her. He asked: With what does he return to her? He (peace be upon him) said: 'With half of what is taught as being like that surah.'

key_terms.سُورَةٍ: A chapter or surah of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the dowry entitlement for a wife divorced before consummation if the dowry was a Quranic surah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that the dowry (mahr) is not limited to currency but can be defined by the teaching of a Quranic surah, establishing a flexible legal precedent for non-monetary marital contracts. It confirms the application of the general Quranic principle of halving the dowry in cases of pre-consummation divorce, demonstrating the Shia scholarly emphasis on the substantive agreement between parties rather than rigid formalism.
